{{Infobox place|name=Crown-watch|type=Seat of [[House Blackcrest]]|region=Edge of [[the Ash Fields]]|house=[[House Blackcrest]]|notable=The Permanent Book; the Ash Urns; conspicuously undefended}}
'''Crown-watch''' is a fortress-city on the edge of [[the Ash Fields]], built to watch over memory, not defend land. Its heart is a library whose innermost room holds the [[Chronicle of Victory|Permanent Book]]. Along its galleries stand '''the Ash Urns''', holding the ash of everything burned out of history by [[The Clean Page|the Clean Page]]. The city is conspicuously undefended: whoever destroys Blackcrest destroys every house's fine story of itself.
